layer: P0 FK input and label-definition audit; exploratory; not method-effect evidence

source_project.guidance_conflict: main research README and roadmap are older; this run follows the more specific v3 P0 crosswalk report and its stated canonical-input correction

research_question: Does filtering invalid FK instances to the canonical P1.5 valid_instances_private set change the v3 P1.5 per-question labels, and which packet-vs-P1.5 differences remain?
hypothesis: The P1.5 adapter should pass only records with boolean valid_endpoints=true, matching run_p1_5_diagnostics.analyze_gold_joins. Changes from the prior wrapper should be attributable only to excluding invalid FK records; any remaining packet differences are implementation-definition differences, not role accuracy.

p1_5_unfiltered_reference.role: frozen comparison reference only; not canonical P1.5

definitions.canonical_fk_adapter: filter raw instances by valid_endpoints is True; reject missing/non-boolean validity flags; assert raw/valid/invalid totals 103/100/3
definitions.packet_parser: frozen reference output only; no re-run

execution_code.runner_change: new run ID plus strict valid_endpoints boolean validation/filter and removal of FK-match count as a pass gate; golden_join_audit itself unchanged
